clauses.reason: Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12297, whose subject line describes executing the International Coffee Agreement of 1976. Section 1 delegates to the United States Trade Representative the functions vested in the President by Public Law 96-599 (the International Coffee Agreement Act of 1980) to carry out and enforce the International Coffee Agreement 1976. No earlier express end was found.

Terminated by express revocation. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 (51 FR 7237, Federal Register of March 3, 1986; held government printing) revokes the orders listed in its table, and any amendments thereto; its enacting provision has no stated effective date, so the first end is dated on signing, 1986-02-25 (a reading, disclosed for the reviewer). The Federal Register publication and filing dates are not effective dates. The table lists 12297, whose subject line describes executing the International Coffee Agreement of 1976. Section 2 directs the Trade Representative to consult the Secretary of Agriculture and the Secretary of State and allows redelegation to the head of another Executive agency with that head’s consent. No earlier express end was found.
